attributes.body_ja:
「くらい」は名詞（めいし）ですが、副助詞（ふくじょし）のように使（つか）われることがあります。このような「くらい」（または「ぐらい」）は、「ほど」のように、何（なに）かの程度（ていど）や限度（げんど）を表（あらわ）します。「だいたい (A) と同（おな）じ程度（ていど） (B)」や「とても (A) なので (B) する」のような意味（いみ）で使（つか）われます。では、例（れい）を見（み）てみましょう。

「位（くらい）」という漢字（かんじ）は、地位（ちい）や身分（みぶん）の段階（だんかい）を表（あらわ）します。この文法の「くらい」も、(B) の実現（じつげん）に必要（ひつよう）な (A) の「程度（ていど）」や「段階（だんかい）」を表（あらわ）すという点（てん）で、漢字（かんじ）の意味（いみ）と似（に）ていると言（い）えるでしょう。
attributes.body:
Often, the noun くらい is used as an adverbial particle. This use of くらい (or ぐらい) expresses the limit of something, in a similar way to ほど. This means that it can be translated as 'about (A)', 'so (A) that (B)', or '(A) to the extent of (B)'. Let's take a look at a few examples.

Despite translating in the above ways, we can see that this use of くらい is similar to the standard kanji use 位（くらい）, which literally means a 'rank', or 'grade' of something. What this means is that (A) will usually be considered to be at the 'grade' of something that was required in order to cause/allow (B).

attributes.source: [AIAIJ] An Integrated Approach to Intermediate Japanese

attributes.description: The difference between ほど and くらい

attributes.body: くらい (often ぐらい in speech) expresses an approximate degree or extent. It's commonly used with number + counter expressions (the くらい① form), as in 100円くらい = 'about 100 yen.' It can also be used like ほど to express extent or degree, as in 足が動けなくなるくらい走った = 'I ran so much my legs couldn't move anymore.'

second_relatable.title: くらい ②
second_relatable.meaning: To the extent that, So…that, About the only thing that...

attributes.body: Both くらい and ほど can express extent in the sense of 'so much that (A)' or 'to the extent of (A)', and are often interchangeable, e.g. 驚くくらい静かだった / 驚くほど静かだった ('It was quiet to a surprising degree.') くらい (also written as ぐらい) tends to sound slightly more colloquial, and each word has other uses where they may not be interchangeable.

first_relatable.title: くらい ②
first_relatable.meaning: To the extent that, So…that, About the only thing that...

second_relatable.title: ほど
second_relatable.meaning: The more, About, To the extent that, So much… that

attributes.body: Both まで and ほど share the core meaning of 'to the extent of,' but are used differently. まで emphasizes inclusivity or a surprising limit, e.g. 骨まで食べた ('He even ate the bones.'). In contrast, くらい② means 'to the point of' and often expresses degree, e.g. 叫びたいくらい怖かった ('It was so scary I wanted to scream.').
